brief:
Israel has blocked the establishment of a civil administration to replace Hamas in Gaza, creating a governance vacuum that leaves Palestinians without functional alternatives, +972 Magazine reported. The obstruction prevents any successor authority from taking root, even as international actors and Palestinian factions attempt to plan the territory's postwar administration.

The power void reflects Israel's rejection of Palestinian self-governance options while Hamas remains the only organized force capable of administering the enclave. Without a recognized civilian government, Palestinians face an absence of institutional structures to manage essential services, coordinate reconstruction, or establish legitimacy with residents in the aftermath of conflict.
dek: By blocking a civil government from replacing Hamas, Israel has created a power vacuum in Gaza — and left Palestinians with nowhere to turn.
title: Israel's blockade of Gaza civil government leaves power vacuum
